summary: Presents the Softwire Mesh framework for carrying IPv4 and IPv6 across single-protocol networks, such as ones that handle only IPv4 or only IPv6. The goal is for both to work on the Internet as the transition takes place.

eli5.summary: Some networks speak only the old addresses and some only the new. This framework uses tunnels so both kinds of traffic can cross the other's territory.

questions: how to carry ipv6 over an ipv4 only core
